purpose: Improve inspectable visual creation states in simulation and resolve adaptive vector-cell fabrics whose stable cells may deliberately merge child detail at one observation scale or split back into child cells at another, while keeping every selected state explicit and refusing to call current knowledge perfect.

properties.operation: optional explicit operation; resolve-vector-cells selects Vector Cell Fabric resolution, otherwise normal creation simulation runs
properties.thought: simulation path: inspectable visual scene state with canvas and objects; objects may begin with incomplete Paintgun channels
properties.defaults: simulation path: optional caller-visible channel defaults available to the simulator
properties.alternatives: simulation path: optional per-object known alternative channel values available to improvement rules
properties.palette: simulation path: optional known color candidates used for missing color and contrast improvement
properties.criteria: simulation path: optional deterministic criteria such as minimum_contrast and fit_canvas
properties.max_iterations: simulation path: optional explicit simulation bound from 1 to 32
properties.fabric: vector-cell path: hierarchical axm.vector-cell-fabric/v0.1 body with stable cell ids and explicit representations
properties.observation_scale: vector-cell path: positive scale used to select each cell representation
properties.choice: vector-cell path: explicit named chameleon choice; exact choice representations override generic ones

contains: simulation iteration history or vector-cell resolution trace
known improvement/gap evidence or merge/split evidence

relationships: simulation happens before reality materialization rather than only testing after a draft is built
the stopping state NO_KNOWN_IMPROVEMENTS means no currently registered improvement rule can identify another change, not perfection
Vector Cell Fabric stores stable visual identities whose explicit representation may merge child cells for a coarse view or split into child cells when finer detail is requested
vector-cell choice is explicit rather than hidden adaptation: a named choice may select a different representation while the cell id remains stable
resolved vector cells become ordinary Paintgun thought and can therefore enter the existing simulate -> NO_KNOWN_IMPROVEMENTS -> Paintgun materialize loop

anatomy_refs.basis: The simulated visual thought keeps shape, surface, color, light, shade and skin parameters as an inspectable compositional graph before rendering.
Simulation advances through explicit state transitions and terminates in a typed NO_KNOWN_IMPROVEMENTS or HOLD state.
Vector cells select one exact scale-bound representation and can collapse child cells into a parent expression or expand the same parent identity into child cells.
Nested vector cells retain explicit parent/child paths and resolve them into one inspectable scene graph before Paintgun rendering.

limitations: simulation improvement rules remain bounded to the explicitly implemented rules
NO_KNOWN_IMPROVEMENTS is not optimality, perfection, semantic correctness, or aesthetic proof
Vector Cell Fabric v0 selects only explicitly supplied representations and never invents missing close-up detail
merged and split cell forms preserve structural identity but do not prove physical equivalence
vector geometry remains resolution-independent until rasterization at an observation/output boundary; raster effects and physical detail still have their own limits
v0 cell transforms intentionally do not rewrite SVG path data

truth.basis: Every adaptive representation, observation scale, choice, merge/split transition and resulting thought digest stays inspectable; the system does not claim infinite detail or perfection.

agency.basis: Scale and chameleon choice are explicit caller state, and choice-specific representations override generic ones without silently changing cell identity.

continuity.basis: A cell keeps one stable identity while its selected expression changes; resolving cells is read-only and produces a normal thought before any materialization.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: Adaptive detail is selected from known representations and may enter the existing simulation evidence loop before the result is pulled into reality.
